sloka: प्रविवेश अथ रामः तु स्व वेश्म सुविभूषितम् ।प्रहृष्ट जन सम्पूर्णम् ह्रिया किम्चित् अवान् मुखः ॥२-२६-५॥
transliteration: praviveśa atha rāmaḥ tu sva veśma suvibhūṣitam ।prahṛṣṭa jana sampūrṇam hriyā kimcit avān mukhaḥ ॥2-26-5॥

translations.english: His head bent down in embarrassment, Rama entered his welldecorated residence thronged with excited people.
